lines.t: Yeah...
This isn't temporary.
This is forever.
Let’s go.
I see You moving in the morning light
I felt Your Spirit through the longest night
They say the world is gonna fade away
But I’m leaning on the words You say
I used to wander, used to lose my breath
But You pulled me from the sting of death
Now every heartbeat is a rhythmic sign
That I am Yours and Lord, You are mine.
If I wrote a thousand songs, it wouldn’t be enough
To describe the weight of Your redeeming love
It’s deeper than the ocean, higher than the stars
I’m healed by the stripes and the scars.
I’m giving You my life, my soul, my heart (Everything)
I knew I loved You from the very start (The King)
It’s a different kind of grace, a different kind of glow
Everywhere I go, I’m gonna let ‘em know
This love... is eternal.
This love... is the Way.
Ay, look—
I was chasing shadows, running for the temporary
Until I met the Visionary, now it’s secondary
Everything I thought I needed, I just laid it down
Traded in the ashes for a holy crown
He the Rock, He the Shepherd, He the Living Water
Accepted by the Father as a chosen son
No more condemnation, yeah the debt is paid
Walkin' in the light, I am not afraid!
[Outro]
It’s eternal.
It’s eternal.
Yeah.
My Love. Your Grace.
